title: Bethesda Softworks
summary: Supported AAA launches through QA across hardware, platforms, and teams. Worked on franchises including Skyrim, Fallout, Dishonored, and Wolfenstein.
body:
### Games I worked on

As a QA tester at Bethesda Softworks, I supported game quality across hardware, platforms, and teams. My primary projects included Creation Club content for Skyrim and Fallout 4, alongside Fallout 76, Death of the Outsider, and Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus.

- [Skyrim Creation Club](https://bethesda.net/en-US/news/fallout-4-and-skyrim-special-edition-creation-club)
- [Fallout 4 Creation Club](https://bethesda.net/en-US/news/fallout-4-and-skyrim-special-edition-creation-club)
- [Fallout 76](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151340/)
- [Dishonored: Death of the Outsider](https://store.steampowered.com/app/614570/)
- [Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus](https://store.steampowered.com/app/612880/)

Official game artwork below; my Skyrim and Fallout 4 work focused on Creation Club.
